author: Quinn's Ideas
description:
The Area X series is one of the most disturbing, and mindbending modern science fiction series. The first book in the series Annihilation was adapted into a movie in 2018 but the book is quite different and more complex compared to the film. There are also three sequels. Authority, Acceptance, and Absolution. Now, I have already done two videos covering the other three books, one of which is over an hour long. You can find those videos linked in the description. This video will mainly focus on piecing together the bits of information and revelations revealed in Absolution and try to understand how it relates to what we’ve read in previous books and how it all can help us understand the nature of Area X and all of the strange and horrific events that occur near and within it.
